title: Materialized Frontmatter Schema
description: JSON Schema validating the materialized structural metadata under the 'wiki' key in Markdown YAML frontmatter.

fragments.description: Map from normalized heading anchor to fragment metrics

tokens.description: Complete integer count of BPE tokens in this fragment

inbound.description: Count of inbound references specifically targeting this fragment anchor

outbound.description: Count of outbound references originating inside this fragment
